name: request_human
description: Flag that this conversation needs a person: bulk quotes, order changes, complaints, anything about a specific customer's account or payment. Call it once, then tell the customer someone will pick it up.

request_body_schema.description: Why this conversation needs a person, and which conversation it is.

properties.description: One line on what they need, for the staff picking it up.
Issued by the conversation-initiation webhook. Without it the handoff is never recorded and nobody learns the customer asked for a person.
